notes.title: AGEOD special Sales
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[b]Don’t miss out on our special deal on the entire AGEOD games catalog.[/b]

If you haven’t heard yet, on[b] June 4th[/b], we are releasing our new strategic 4X game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34556788/2208a629574e40e2e9d50bc0f2cd4cbab53be7cb.jpg[/img]

[b]Field of Glory: Kingdoms[/b] is the latest game from the award-winning studio AGEOD, known for creating some of the best grand strategy games of all time. Set in 1054, just after the Great Schism, it covers more than two centuries of epic European, African, and Middle Eastern history.

[b]Here's a quick overview of the game:[/b]
[list]
[*] 375 factions
[*] 325 units
[*] 600 buildings
[*] 14 religions/heresies
[*] 90 cultural traits (all new)
[/list]

If you want to learn more, follow the game on:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1985050/Field_of_Glory_Kingdoms/

[url=https://discord.gg/3Xrm3ge5wQ]Join our Discord community[/url]


And don't forget to check out the Dev Diaries:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1985050/view/4178854131307887205

notes.title: Revolution Under Siege Gold has been updated to version 1.01c!
notes.content:
Revolution never Sleeps! It is time to raise once again, since [b]Revolution Under Siege Gold[/b] has been updated to version 1.01c!

[u]Patch 1.01c changelog[/u]
1 - New EXE; with air reconnaissance duration and elements-click bug in construction mode both fixed
2 - German language fixed
3 - New strategic map now included in the docs folder
4 - Music ini file fixed
5 - Menu links updated and fixed

notes.title: Revolution Under Siege Gold is Released and Streamed!
notes.content:
[i]“The battleline between good and evil runs through the heart of every man.”[/i]- Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn

Brest-Litovsk didn’t bring peace to a battered Russia. The divisions inside the [i]Russian Social-Democratic Labour Party[/i] see the minority faction – the [b]Mensheviks[/b] - always struggling against the majority one – the [b]Bolsheviks[/b]. Meanwhile border countries once part of the Russian Empire are considering the possibility of taking advantage of their former “Motherland”...

[b]Revolution Under Siege GOLD[/b], the first complete historical simulation on PC of the Russian Civil War between 1917 and 1923, [b]is out now![/b]

[b]A wealth of historical events and geopolitical options[/b], real or possible according to the player's choices,[b] will bring a realistic tempo to the manoeuvre of your forces and those of your opponents alongside dozens of new features and bug fixes![/b]

Embrace the Revolution or fight to preserve the debris of the Old Society!

[b]Watch the Stream of the game today at 20:00 CEST / 18:00 UTC / 2:00 PM EDT[/b] on our official [url=http://www.twitch.tv/slitherinegroup]Twitch Channel[/url]!
